name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a bench, grip slightly wider than shoulder width, lower the bar to your mid chest, then press back up until your arms are extended.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest level, press both up until arms are extended, then lower with control.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Set the bench to a 30-45 degree incline and press the bar from your upper chest back up to full extension.

name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: On an incline bench, press two dumbbells from upper chest height up and slightly together, then lower with control.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: On a decline bench, lower the bar to your lower chest and press back up to full extension.

name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lie flat with arms extended above your chest and a slight elbow bend, open your arms out wide, then bring them back together in an arc.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
instructions: From an incline bench, open your arms out wide with a slight elbow bend and bring them back together above your upper chest.

name: Cable Fly
instructions: Stand between two high pulleys and bring the handles together in front of your chest in a hugging arc, then return slowly.

name: Low to High Cable Fly
instructions: Set pulleys low and sweep the handles up and together in front of your chest, emphasizing the upper chest.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: From high pulleys, cross the handles over each other in front of your body, squeezing the chest at the end of the motion.

name: Push Up
instructions: In a high plank with hands shoulder width apart, lower your chest to the floor and press back up keeping your body straight.

name: Incline Push Up
instructions: Perform a push up with your hands elevated on a bench or box to reduce the load.

name: Decline Push Up
instructions: Perform a push up with your feet elevated on a bench to shift load to the upper chest and shoulders.

name: Chest Dip
instructions: Lean your torso forward on parallel bars and lower until your shoulders are below your elbows, then press back up.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Sit at the chest press machine, grip the handles at chest height, and press forward until your arms are extended.

name: Pec Deck Fly
instructions: Sit with elbows at chest height against the pads and squeeze the arms together in front of your chest, then return slowly.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
instructions: Press the fixed barbell from your mid chest back up to full extension on the Smith machine.

name: Landmine Press
instructions: Press the anchored barbell up and forward from shoulder height while standing, driving with your upper chest.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Lie across a bench and sweep a dumbbell from over your chest back behind your head in an arc, then return.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a flat back and lift the bar from the floor by extending your hips and knees to a standing position.

name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Set a wide stance with toes out, grip inside your knees, and extend hips and knees to stand tall.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: With soft knees, hinge at the hips lowering the bar along your thighs until you feel a hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.

name: Pull Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders and pull your chin above the bar.

name: Chin Up
instructions: Hang with an underhand, shoulder width grip and pull your chin above the bar, then lower with control.

name: Neutral Grip Pull Up
instructions: Hang from parallel handles with palms facing each other and pull your chin above your hands.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit with thighs secured, pull the bar down to your upper chest by driving your elbows down, then return slowly.

name: Close Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Use a narrow, neutral grip handle and pull it down to your chest, squeezing your lats.

name: Barbell Bent Over Row
instructions: Hinge to about 45 degrees with a flat back, pull the bar to your lower ribs, then lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Bent Over Row
instructions: Hinge forward and row both dumbbells up to your ribs, keeping elbows close to your body.

name: One Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Brace one hand on a bench and row a dumbbell up to your hip with the other, then lower fully.

name: Machine Chest Supported Row
instructions: With your chest against the pad, row the handles to your torso and squeeze your shoulder blades together.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Pull the handle to your torso with upright posture, then let your arms extend fully forward.

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Straddle the anchored bar, hinge forward, and row the weight up to your chest.

name: Pendlay Row
instructions: From a dead stop on the floor each rep, explosively row the bar to your lower chest with a flat back.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Pull a rope attachment toward your face, splitting your hands beside your ears, keeping elbows high.

name: Straight Arm Pulldown
instructions: With arms nearly straight, sweep the bar from shoulder height down to your thighs using your lats.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Hold the bar at hip level and raise your shoulders straight up toward your ears, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and raise your shoulders toward your ears without bending your elbows.

name: Good Morning
instructions: With the bar on your upper back and soft knees, hinge at the hips until your torso is near horizontal, then stand back up.

name: Back Extension
instructions: On a hyperextension bench, lower your torso with control and raise back to a straight line with your legs.

name: Inverted Row
instructions: Under a fixed bar, hang with a straight body and row your chest up to the bar.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
instructions: Press the bar from shoulder height overhead until your arms are locked out, keeping your core braced.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Press two dumbbells from shoulder height overhead until your arms are extended.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Seated with back support, press dumbbells from shoulder height straight up and lower with control.

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Start with palms facing you at shoulder height and rotate your palms outward as you press overhead.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: With a slight elbow bend, raise dumbbells out to your sides to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Raise the low pulley handle out to your side to shoulder height, keeping your arm nearly straight.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Raise one or both dumbbells straight in front of you to shoulder height, then lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Hinge forward and raise dumbbells out wide with a slight elbow bend, squeezing your rear delts.

name: Machine Rear Delt Fly
instructions: With chest against the pad, sweep your arms back and open until level with your shoulders.

name: Cable Rear Delt Row
instructions: Row the rope toward your upper chest with elbows wide, focusing on your rear delts.

name: Barbell Upright Row
instructions: Pull the bar up along your body to chest height with elbows leading, then lower slowly.

name: Plate Front Raise
instructions: Hold a weight plate with both hands and raise it straight ahead to eye level, then lower.

name: Band Face Pull
instructions: Anchor the band at face height, pull it toward your face and split your hands beside your ears.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Curl the bar from hip height to shoulder height keeping your elbows pinned at your sides.

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Curl both dumbbells up, rotating your palms to face up as you lift.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Curl one dumbbell at a time, alternating arms while keeping your torso still.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Curl dumbbells with palms facing each other throughout the movement.

name: Preacher Curl
instructions: With upper arms against the preacher pad, curl the weight up and lower slowly to full extension.

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Seated with your elbow braced against your inner thigh, curl the dumbbell up and squeeze at the top.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with arms hanging and curl both dumbbells through a long range.

name: Spider Curl
instructions: Chest down on an incline bench, curl both dumbbells with your arms hanging vertically.

name: EZ Bar Curl
instructions: Curl the EZ bar up with a shoulder width grip, keeping elbows fixed at your sides.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Curl the low pulley bar up keeping constant tension through the whole range.

name: Rope Hammer Curl
instructions: Curl the rope handles with palms facing each other, splitting them at the top.

name: Band Curl
instructions: Stand on the band and curl your hands up, keeping tension in the band at all times.

name: Close Grip Bench Press
instructions: Grip the bar at shoulder width, lower to your lower chest, and press back up driving with your triceps.

name: Barbell Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a bench and lower the bar toward your forehead by bending your elbows, then extend back up.

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
instructions: Lower two dumbbells beside your head by bending the elbows, then extend back up.

name: Triceps Dip
instructions: On parallel bars keep your torso vertical, lower until elbows reach 90 degrees, and press back up.

name: Bench Dip
instructions: With hands on a bench behind you, lower your hips toward the floor and press back up.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
instructions: With elbows pinned at your sides, push the bar down until your arms are fully extended.

name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Push the rope down and split your hands apart at the bottom of the movement.

name: Overhead Dumbbell Extension
instructions: Lower a dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbows, then extend back up overhead.

name: Overhead Cable Extension
instructions: Facing away from a high pulley, extend the rope overhead until your arms are straight.

name: Triceps Kickback
instructions: Hinged forward, extend your forearm back until your arm is straight, squeezing the triceps.

name: Diamond Push Up
instructions: Place your hands close together forming a diamond under your chest, lower down, and press back up.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: With the bar on your upper back, squat down until your hips reach knee level or below, then drive up through your heels.

name: Front Squat
instructions: Hold the bar on your front delts with elbows high and squat down, keeping an upright torso.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a weight at your chest and squat down between your legs, keeping your chest up.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Push the platform away until your legs are nearly straight, then lower until your knees reach about 90 degrees.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: On the hack sled, lower with control until knees are bent past 90 degrees and press back up.

name: Smith Machine Squat
instructions: Squat under the fixed bar, keeping your feet slightly forward to sit back into the movement.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Step forward into a long stride and lower your back knee toward the floor, then step through to the next lunge.

name: Static Lunge
instructions: From a split stance, lower your back knee straight down and push back up without stepping.

name: Reverse Lunge
instructions: Step backward into a lunge, lowering until both knees are bent 90 degrees, then return to standing.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot elevated on a bench, lower straight down until your front thigh is parallel, then drive up.

name: Dumbbell Step Up
instructions: Step up onto a box driving through your top leg, then lower with control.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Extend your knees until your legs are straight, pause, and lower the pad slowly.

name: Sissy Squat
instructions: Rise to your toes and lean back while bending your knees, keeping hips extended, then return.

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Slide down a wall until your thighs are parallel to the floor and hold the position.

name: Pistol Squat
instructions: Squat down on one leg with the other extended forward, then stand back up.

name: Squat Jump
instructions: Squat down and explode upward into a jump, landing softly back into a squat.

name: Stiff Leg Deadlift
instructions: With nearly straight legs, hinge at the hips to lower the bar along your legs, then stand by extending your hips.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Face down on the bench, curl the pad toward your glutes and lower slowly.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Curl the pad under your seat toward your hamstrings, pause, and return with control.

name: Nordic Curl
instructions: Kneeling with ankles fixed, lower your torso forward as slowly as possible and pull back up.

name: Glute Ham Raise
instructions: From the GHR bench, extend your body backward and curl back up using your hamstrings and glutes.

name: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hinge forward on one leg while the other extends behind you, keeping a flat back, then stand up.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: With upper back on a bench and the bar over your hips, drive your hips up until your body is level, squeeze, and lower.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lying on your back, drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes, then lower with control.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
instructions: Ankle strap at a low pulley, kick your leg straight back and up, squeezing the glute.

name: Hip Abduction
instructions: Push the pads apart with your legs, pause at the widest point, and return slowly.

name: Box Step Down
instructions: Stand on a box and lower one foot to the floor with control, then drive back up.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as possible, pause at the top, and lower into a deep stretch.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: With the pad on your knees, press through the balls of your feet and lift your heels.

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions: Holding dumbbells, rise onto your toes on a step or flat floor and lower into a stretch.

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
instructions: On the leg press, push the platform with the balls of your feet and control the return.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Hinged forward under the pad, raise your heels through a full range.

name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions: With a dumbbell across your knees, raise your heels as high as possible.

name: Tibialis Raise
instructions: With heels on a step, pull your toes up toward your shins and lower slowly.

name: Plank
instructions: Hold a straight line from head to heels on your forearms, bracing your core.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Balance on one forearm with your body in a straight line and hips lifted.

name: Crunch
instructions: Curl your shoulder blades off the floor by contracting your abs, then lower slowly.

name: Sit Up
instructions: From lying with bent knees, sit all the way up and return with control.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar and raise your legs to hip height or above, then lower slowly without swinging.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar and pull your knees up toward your chest, then lower with control.

name: Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lying flat, raise straight legs to vertical and lower them slowly without touching the floor.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Seated with feet off the floor, rotate your torso side to side touching the weight beside your hip.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneeling below a high pulley, crunch your ribs toward your hips and return with control.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Roll the wheel forward keeping your core braced, then pull back to the start.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: On your back, extend opposite arm and leg while keeping your lower back pressed to the floor.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: In a plank, drive your knees alternately toward your chest at speed.

name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Press your lower back down and hold your shoulders and legs just off the floor.

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
instructions: Holding a dumbbell on one side, bend sideways to lower it and pull back up with your obliques.

name: Medicine Ball Slam
instructions: Raise the ball overhead and slam it down with full force, hinging at the hips.

name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Forearms on a bench, curl your wrists up and lower slowly.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Palms down on a bench, extend your wrists up and lower slowly.

name: Farmer Carry
instructions: Walk with heavy weights at your sides, keeping posture tall and grip tight.

name: Dead Hang
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms as long as you can.

name: Reverse Curl
instructions: Curl with palms facing down to target the forearm extensors.

name: Wrist Roller
instructions: Roll the handle up and down to wind the cord around it, working your forearms.

name: Plate Pinch Hold
instructions: Pinch two plates together at your side and hold for time.

name: Neck Flexion
instructions: Lying on your back, tuck your chin to your chest against resistance and return.

name: Neck Extension
instructions: Lying face down, raise your head backward against resistance and lower slowly.

name: Treadmill Run
instructions: Run at a steady pace on the treadmill, adjusting speed or incline for intensity.

name: Stationary Bike
instructions: Cycle at a steady cadence, adjusting resistance for the desired intensity.

name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Drive with your legs, then pull the handle to your chest in one fluid motion, and recover.

name: Jump Rope
instructions: Skip rope with light bounces from your ankles, keeping a steady rhythm.

name: Burpee
instructions: From standing, drop into a push up, jump your feet in, and leap upward.

name: Stair Climber
instructions: Climb at a steady pace keeping your torso upright.

name: Elliptical
instructions: Move in a smooth elliptical stride, adjusting resistance and incline.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hike the kettlebell back between your legs and snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.

name: Kettlebell Clean
instructions: Pull the kettlebell from the floor to your shoulder in one controlled motion, catching it softly.

name: Kettlebell Snatch
instructions: Explosively swing the kettlebell from the floor to a locked out position overhead.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold the kettlebell at your chest and squat between your legs keeping your chest up.

name: Kettlebell Overhead Lunge
instructions: Hold a kettlebell overhead and lunge forward, keeping the arm locked out.

name: Clean and Press
instructions: Pull the bar from the floor to your shoulders, then press it overhead in one continuous effort.

name: Power Clean
instructions: Explosively pull the bar from the floor to your shoulders catching it in a quarter squat.

name: Push Press
instructions: Dip slightly at the knees and drive the bar overhead, using leg momentum to press.

name: Thruster
instructions: Squat down with the bar at your shoulders and drive up into an overhead press in one motion.

name: Muscle Up
instructions: Pull up explosively and transition over the bar, pressing to a support position above it.

name: Box Jump
instructions: Explode from a quarter squat onto a stable box, landing softly, then step down.

name: Battle Ropes
instructions: Create rapid alternating waves with the ropes in an athletic stance.

name: Assault Bike
instructions: Push and pull the handles while pedaling at a self-selected sprint or pace.

name: Sled Push
instructions: Drive the sled forward with powerful, low, short steps.

name: Band Assisted Pull Up
instructions: Loop a band over the bar and under your knees to assist your pull ups.

name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Press the fixed bar overhead from chin height while seated on the Smith bench.

name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
instructions: Thrust your hips up against the Smith bar positioned over your hips.

name: Band Pull Apart
instructions: Stretch the band apart in front of your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.

name: Band Lat Pulldown
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and pull it down to your chest like a pulldown.

name: Band Chest Press
instructions: Anchor the band behind you and press forward until your arms are extended.

name: Band Overhead Press
instructions: Stand on the band and press both hands overhead until your arms lock out.

name: Band Row
instructions: Anchor the band in front of you and row the ends toward your torso.

name: Kettlebell Around the World
instructions: Pass the kettlebell around your waist, switching hands in front and behind.

name: Kettlebell Press
instructions: Press the kettlebell overhead from your shoulder, keeping your wrist straight.

name: Single Arm Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Swing the kettlebell to chest height with one arm, driving with your hips.

name: Kettlebell Row
instructions: Hinge forward and row the kettlebell to your hip with a flat back.

name: Single Arm Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand beside a low pulley and raise the handle out to your side to shoulder height.

name: Chest Supported Dumbbell Row
instructions: Lying prone on an incline bench, row both dumbbells toward your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades.

name: Smith Machine Row
instructions: Hinge under the Smith bar and row it to your torso.

name: Cable Upright Row
instructions: Pull the low pulley bar up along your body to chest height with elbows leading.

name: Prone Cobra
instructions: Lying face down, lift your chest with arms at your sides and rotate your palms out, squeezing your back.

name: 45 Degree Glute Extension
instructions: On a 45 degree bench, extend your hips to raise your torso to a straight line.

name: Banded Glute Bridge
instructions: With a band above your knees, bridge your hips up pushing your knees out against the band.

name: Clamshell
instructions: Lying on your side with a band above your knees, open your knees apart keeping your feet together.

name: Banded Lateral Walk
instructions: With a band above your knees, side step in a semi squat keeping tension.

name: Cable Hip Abduction
instructions: Ankle strap at a low pulley, sweep your leg out to the side against the cable.

name: Slide Leg Curl
instructions: On sliders, curl your heels toward your glutes by lifting your hips and sliding your feet in.

name: Reverse Hyperextension
instructions: Swing your legs back and up over the bench using your glutes, not your lower back.

name: Cable Pull Through
instructions: Between your legs pull the rope through by driving your hips forward to standing.

name: Sumo Squat
instructions: Wide stance with toes out, squat straight down holding a weight at your chest.

name: Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Step one leg behind and across your body into a lunge, then return to standing.

name: Lateral Lunge
instructions: Step wide to one side, sit back into that hip, then push back to center.

name: L-Sit
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars and hold your straight legs out in front of you.

name: Scapular Pull Up
instructions: From a dead hang, pull your shoulder blades down without bending your elbows.

name: Shrimp Squat
instructions: Balance on one leg holding your other foot behind you and squat down to the floor.

name: Machine Glute Kickback
instructions: Push the lever back and up with your leg, squeezing the glute at the top.

name: Hip Adduction
instructions: Squeeze the pads together in front of you and return slowly.

name: Band Assisted Nordic Curl
instructions: Perform nordic curls with a band under your chest to reduce the load.
